# Slipway docs

> Build on Slipway. Ship Seaworthy. An editorial, RTL-ready, agent-native site template for GitHub Pages.

The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [Configure](https://github.com/guide/configure/): Change the look of the site with a few lines in _config.yml.
- [Deploy](https://github.com/guide/deploy/): Publish the built site on GitHub Pages.
- [Overview](https://github.com/guide/): What the guide covers and how the pages are organised.
- [Install](https://github.com/guide/install/): Add the theme to a site with the gem, a remote theme, or the template.
- [Write pages](https://github.com/guide/write/): Front matter, headings, and code blocks in a documentation page.

## Pages

- [Docs for a Slipway site](https://github.com/): A documentation site built on the doc layout, with a sidebar, a table of contents, and previous and next links.
